set -e
cd "$WORK"
mkdir build
cd build
cmake   -G"Unix Makefiles"   -DWITH_PTHREADS=OFF -DWITH_OPENMP=OFF   -DWITH_PUGIXML=OFF -DUSE_XMLLINT=OFF -DWITH_JPEG=OFF -DWITH_ZLIB=OFF   -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF -DBUILD_TOOLS=OFF -DBUILD_BENCHMARKING=OFF   -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=FUZZ -DBUILD_FUZZERS=ON   -DLIBFUZZER_ARCHIVE:FILEPATH="$LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE"   -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX:PATH="$OUT" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR:PATH="$OUT"   "$SRC/librawspeed/"
make -j$(nproc) all && make -j$(nproc) install
cd "$SRC"
rm -rf "$WORK/build"
